name: Временная турель
subject: A compact fantasy brass-and-iron automatic CROSSBOW turret on three stout wood/metal folding legs. Mounted wooden bow arms, taut string, brass rotating swivel, teal small rune power gem, one steel-tipped bolt clearly emerging along its central straight firing rail. Low stable silhouette, detailed mechanical bracing, no modern firearm, sci-fi scope, steam smoke or multiple arrows. Navy/teal backdrop.
caption: Небольшая автономная арбалетная турель на устойчивой треноге.
